_comment: Diagnostic scheme: makes the application's own logging emit, so you can see whether a message reaches the app. This ships `diagnostic-logmask` alone, deliberately - it forces the global trace mask that gates `Log_msg`, which turns on the ~5900 call sites already compiled in, including `HandleAudioAuxInputStatusChnged()` logging its own name on every exit. That is the open question in docs/VERIFICATION.md, answered without changing any behaviour. Add `diagnostic-logging` as well if you also want the ~6700 stubbed-out sites, but expect a flood. Do not drive on either. Before flashing, settle where Log_msg writes - if it is serial-only this needs routing somewhere readable first.
